ANNOUNCEMENT: 

We are happy to inform everyone who has been waiting for us to give some feedback on our games were abouts, that we are officially wrapping up Alpha testing and all players on steam will have the chance later next month to strap in and drop in the midst of an ongoing battle. Over the next couple of days will be sharing screenshots and gameplay taken from players that was conducted during open alpha testing.
We had alot of delays due to Unreal engine 5.1 being super unstable and we have had the oppertunity to upgrade the game finially to unreal engine 5.2.1. Firestorm Deadlands will be heading up to steamworks team for validation to be cleared for early access development only. 



STAY TUNED FOR MORE INFORMATION
